First-touch grading (triage seat): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, type Task, **measure-first**. The mechanism (identity refresh riding an undeclared token-spelling accident, re-arm costing one `get-session`) is client-internal architecture — verification strategy and mechanism choice are seat/dev discretion, not a maintainer decision, so this does not go to the inbox.

Dispatch shape: (1) first prove or disprove reachability — can a user complete two org switches inside one `get-session` round trip, in a frame they can act in? (2) If unreachable: record the measurement on this card and close latent-not-live — PR #5749's pin already makes any change to the mechanism visible, which is the durable half. (3) If reachable: implement the cheapest re-arm that doesn't double-fetch the common path (the card's own candidate: re-resolve only when the switch actually changed the active organization). The over-permissive direction, if reachable, is the same class as #5619/#5719 — client-side gating only, no server authz impact, so no security escalation.
